title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.5
subtitle: Smooth interaction without automatic mesh validation.

highlights.title: No more validation pauses while editing
highlights.description: Assignment, property changes, object edits, and dependency-graph updates now mark the scene dirty without scanning mesh or pin data.

highlights.title: Authoritative checks stay where they matter
highlights.description: Full topology, pin, evaluated-mesh, and collider validation runs only when Validate, Bake, or Rebake explicitly requests it.
